rows.label: Renewal of support for expanding First Nations’ reserve lands

rows.label: Residential Schools Legacy: National Centre for Truth and Reconciliation

Information sharing – pension administrators
rows.description: This measure proposes to allow the CRA to share information with an administrator of a registered pension plan about the death of a member who is entitled to an unclaimed pension benefit.

rows.label: Registered pension plans
rows.description: This measure introduces specific and clear tax consequences where the CRA revokes the registration of a registered pension plan that does not comply with registration conditions. In addition, it strengthens the integrity rules that apply to individual pension plans.

rows.label: Federal fuel excise tax licensing framework
rows.description: The measure proposes updates to the fuel excise tax licensing framework and to provide relief for certain past instances where unintended tax burdens occurred.

rows.label: GST/HST health measures
rows.description: This measure proposes to exempt the supply of qualifying massage therapy services and zero-rate devices specially designed to treat cancer using alternating electric field therapy for GST/HST purposes.

rows.label: Interest deductibility limits
rows.description: This measure proposes to expand the exceptions to the excessive interest and financing expenses limitation rules for purpose-built rental housing and regulated energy utility businesses to cover indirect funding within an affiliated group and by broadening the scope of a regulated energy utility business to incorporate prices set by Crown corporations and through government-operated markets.

rows.label: The Public Service Occupational Health Program
rows.description: Funding proposed for HC to renew occupational health services, medical advice, and guidance that protect federal workers, including correctional officers, border services officers, and other employees who require mandatory occupational health evaluations.

rows.label: Supporting employees affected by workplace injuries
rows.description: Funding proposed for CSC to meet its statutory obligations as an employer with respect to workplace injury, including physical and psychological injuries.

rows.label: Supporting the accountability and modernisation of the Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP)
rows.description: Funding proposed for the RCMP to support the implementation of findings from external reviews and the Management Advisory Board, which is a legislated advisory body that provides the RCMP Commissioner with independent expert advice in areas such as governance, risk management, and resource stewardship.

rows.label: Strengthening the Courts Administration Service (CAS)
rows.description: Funding proposed for CAS to support compliance with the Official Languages Act and reduce the existing translation backlog, help the Federal Court manage elevated caseloads, as well as complete work to modernise the infrastructure that supports Canada’s national courts.
